pageTitle: Calculate Your University of Michigan GPA

officialLinks.label: Transfer credit and U-M campus grades

helpIntro: U-M LSA uses a 4.0 scale. Enter Michigan Semester Hours and final grades; A+/A=4.0, A-=3.7 through D-=0.7, and E=0. The result is a planning estimate.
helpNote: For Ann Arbor LSA undergraduates. P/F and other non-graded marks are excluded, outside transfer grades usually do not count, and repeat treatment needs manual review. Fall 2027 first-semester grade covering needs a separate cohort rule.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12.0 Michigan Honor Points; a 4-credit B+ earns 13.2. Together, 25.2 ÷ 7 = 3.600.

gradeExplanations.E: E earns 0 honor points and is included in GPA.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass/Fail P earns credit but no honor points and is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.F: Pass/Fail F earns no credit or honor points and is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.NC: No Credit notation; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.NR: No Report is temporary and initially excluded; unresolved graded elections may later affect GPA.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is temporary and initially excluded; if unfinished by the deadline it can lapse to E for a graded election.
gradeExplanations.Y: Extended-course notation; initially excluded from GPA.

specialTypes.name: U-M Ann Arbor LSA course
specialTypes.note: Use the LSA grade table for standard Ann Arbor LSA elections.

specialTypes.name: External transfer course
specialTypes.note: Grades from institutions outside the U-M system do not enter the Ann Arbor GPA.

specialTypes.name: UM-Dearborn or UM-Flint course
specialTypes.note: For LSA, grades from UM-Dearborn and UM-Flint transfer and are included in the Ann Arbor GPA.

specialTypes.name: Other U-M school/college or special record
specialTypes.note: School/college grading and repeat rules can differ; verify the home academic unit before calculating.

specialTypes.name: Fall 2027+ LSA first-year first semester
specialTypes.note: LSA plans P/NC grade covering beginning Fall 2027; these first-semester grades do not enter GPA and require cohort-specific review.

repeatPolicy.note: Repeat Impact is disabled. For an LSA repeat, check the original grade and transcript repeat status before deciding whether the later attempt belongs in GPA.
